description: This file implements IEEE 754 half-precision (binary16) floating-point number operations, including conversions between float32 and float16, NaN and infinity handling, and classification functions.

classes.name: Precision
classes.description: Indicates the precision status during conversion, such as exact, inexact, underflow, overflow, or unknown.

methods.name: PrecisionFromfloat32
methods.description: Returns the precision status of converting a float32 to float16 without performing the conversion.

methods.name: Frombits
methods.description: Creates a Float16 from a raw uint16 representation.

methods.name: Fromfloat32
methods.description: Converts a float32 to a Float16 using IEEE default rounding.

methods.name: FromNaN32ps
methods.description: Converts a float32 NaN to a Float16 NaN, preserving signaling and payload.

methods.name: NaN
methods.description: Returns a standard NaN value for Float16.

methods.name: Inf
methods.description: Returns positive or negative infinity for Float16 based on sign.

methods.name: Bits
methods.description: Returns the raw uint16 representation of the Float16.

methods.name: IsNaN
methods.description: Checks if the Float16 value is NaN.

methods.name: IsQuietNaN
methods.description: Checks if the Float16 value is a quiet NaN.

methods.name: IsInf
methods.description: Checks if the Float16 value is infinity, with sign consideration.

methods.name: IsFinite
methods.description: Checks if the Float16 value is finite (not infinity or NaN).

methods.name: IsNormal
methods.description: Checks if the Float16 value is a normalized number.

methods.name: Signbit
methods.description: Checks if the Float16 value has a negative sign.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Float16 value.
